rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something being big in physical size, extent, or scale.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 soeng1 taai3 daai6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a manufactured size such as clothing, shoes, or other standardized products.

example.english: I want to buy these trousers in a large size.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 fu3 ngo5 jiu3 maai5 daai6 maa5
